Annual measured site load and installation costs

telemetry.origin: M4 hourly physical replay and M3 virtual instruments; separate simulated load history for forecasting

assila_water_use.origin: FAO WaPOR raster extraction and NASA POWER temperature analysis; see agriculture/assila/sources.json

tunisia_city_locations.origin: GeoNames administrative seats and geoBoundaries simplified ADM1 geometry; see tunisia/README.md

tunisia_city_relief.origin: Copernicus GLO-90 digital surface model sampled on a 15 × 15 grid at each city; see tunisia/README.md

tunisia_city_climate.origin: NASA POWER 2025 gridded daily archive, aggregated over the selected dates; see tunisia/README.md

agricultural_zone_profiles.origin: ESA WorldCover 2021 crop and landscape classification, Copernicus GLO-90 terrain and NASA POWER 2025 summaries for three published research windows; see field_zones/README.md

regional_planning_irradiation.origin: NASA POWER hourly irradiation at each study point, 15 January and 15 July 2025, converted from UTC to Africa/Tunis; see zone_planning/README.md

regional_reference_et.origin: MIZUHO applies FAO-56 Penman–Monteith to archived NASA POWER radiation, air temperature, dew point, wind and surface pressure. Sector area, crop coefficient, effective rainfall and efficiency are explicit assumptions.

regional_irrigation_plans.origin: M4/M5 fixed and optimized schedules use archived regional sunlight and explicitly entered station and demand assumptions. West and east anchors are classified cropland cells.

pvgis.origin: EC JRC PVGIS-SARAH3 2023 reference-point profiles in tools/m2m3/data/energy; load comparison is simulated

bouhertma.origin: Archived FieldClimate station CSV; see weather/BOUHERTMA.md for time and coverage limitations
